svg.title: Where the score came from, before and after the patch
svg.desc: Bars of 50 blocks, one block = 2 percent. (a) What earned each agent's own score: almost all exploring for the score-trained agent; exploring plus about 12 percent levelling for the capped-score agent. (b) Share of the original score earned on off-route maps: about 17 percent for the score-trained agent, about 17 percent for the capped-score agent re-scored on the original score, 12 percent for random play. (c) Share of each agent's own score earned while grinding battles: 0 before, 22 percent after.
